entries.logic: Iterates through files in a directory and applies a prefix or suffix using 'mv'.
entries.implementation: for file in *; do mv "$file" "${PREFIX}${file}"; done
entries.rationale: Enables quick batch processing of assets and source files during project migrations.

entries.logic: Safely removes build artifacts and cache files to free space and prepare for a clean build.
entries.implementation: rm -rf build/ bin/ out/ target/ && find . -name '*.tmp' -delete
entries.rationale: Core maintenance task to prevent stale binary issues and reduce project size.
